funding.supported_assets_note: USD account funded with stablecoins (USDT/USDC on 10+ chains) and other tokens; non-stablecoin tokens are auto-converted at 2–7% depending on the token (rates on a separate page).

eligibility.usage_note: No official country list found: the site says availability may vary by jurisdiction and is subject to regulatory approval; the fee article mentions a $2 Standard fee for 'certain countries' without naming them. Eligibility is 'to confirm' everywhere until a list is published.

kyc.stages_note: Site refers to identity verification and a 'Verify' step; documents and thresholds not stated on the pages read. Not a no-KYC product.

fees.conditions: Physical card $100 on Standard; 2 virtual cards free then $2 each.
Standard annual fee free ($2 in unnamed countries).
Non-USD card spend 2.0%; USD spend free.
$3 + 2% (plus 2% FX if non-USD); max $250 per withdrawal incl. fees; max 3 withdrawals per rolling 24 h.
Stablecoin deposits free; other tokens auto-converted at 2–7%.
2–7% depending on token (lowest rate modelled); not applied when depositing stablecoins.
Declined-transaction fee $0.50 (insufficient balance only); $0.10 low-authorisation fee on non-USD transactions under $25. Not modelled.
No inactivity fee stated, but a virtual-only account is cancelled if no $5 deposit within 2 weeks of activation.

rewards.conditions: 1.5% cashback 'in dollars' on eligible purchases up to $2,000 eligible spend per month (= $30 cap, calculated); some merchant categories excluded. The help article instead says 'up to 3%' on 2025 spend for Standard — treated as a past programme.

rewards.description: 'Reserve' rewards on USD balances (8% Standard, introductory, ends 2027-07-01 per site; a news item says step-down from January 2027) — a balance reward, not a card reward; not valued.

fees.conditions: 1 physical and 1 virtual card free per year; additional physical $250.

rewards.conditions: 2% up to $10,000 eligible spend per month (= $200, calculated); plus KAST Points worth 1% of eligible spend (no guaranteed monetary value).

access.note: Help article calls this tier 'Luxe'; site calls it 'Private'. A 'Limited' tier ($5,000 once-off) appears only in the help article.

fees.conditions: 1 physical (plated gold) and 1 virtual free per year; additional physical $1,000.

rewards.conditions: 3% up to $40,000 eligible spend per month (= $1,200, calculated); KAST Points worth 2% of eligible spend.

evidence.title: KAST landing page (tiers, cashback, Reserve, FAQ)

editorial.summary: USD stablecoin account with a Visa card. Standard tier is free with 1.5% USD cashback on the first $2,000 of monthly spend, but a physical card costs $100, non-USD spend carries a 2% FX fee and ATM withdrawals cost $3 + 2%. Paid tiers ($1,000 and $10,000 a year) raise the rate and the caps.
good_for: People who hold stablecoins and spend mostly in USD
Virtual-card users (2 free on Standard) with Apple/Google Pay
not_for: Euro-zone spenders (2% FX on every non-USD purchase)
Anyone who needs a published country list or a named issuer before choosing
watch_outs: Issuer not named; custody statements on the site are inconsistent.
Official pages disagree on tier names and cashback figures; this record uses the lower, current landing-page rates.
'Reserve' balance rewards are introductory and their end date is contradictory (Jan vs Jul 2027).
A virtual-only account is cancelled if not funded with $5 within two weeks.
